summary: Diversified Energy Co via subsidiary Diversified Gas Oil Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of interests in affiliates of Camino Natural Resources for $1.175 billion. The acquisition includes developed oil/gas wells and undeveloped acreage in Oklahoma. Carlyle Global Credit will fund 60% of the purchase price for the developed assets, receiving 60% ownership in a special purpose vehicle (SPV); the registrant retains 40% and will operate the assets. The deal is expected to close in Q3 2026, subject to customary conditions and HSR waiting period. Watch for regulatory clearance and financing via asset-backed securitization.
